abstention_reason: ENGINEERING MAINTENANCE PRIORITY ABSTENTION: Actionable bridge maintenance priority, repair work orders, and statutory condition states CANNOT be determined from 2D optical computer vision detections alone. Official engineering prioritization strictly requires: (1) verified structural component identity and load path criticality, (2) physical metric dimensions and internal defect depth from calibrated NDT tools, (3) documented historical progression rates, and (4) formal approval by a licensed Professional Engineer (PE/SE) under agency-adopted maintenance decision criteria. Consequently, official maintenance priority is marked NOT_ASSESSED.
missing_engineering_prerequisites: Verified structural component identity (BIM or inspection plan)
Element load path criticality (AASHTO / NBI element classification)
Physical metric defect dimensions (calibrated optical/laser measurement)
Internal defect depth & delamination plane (NDT sounding, GPR, or UPV)
Formal validation and sign-off by a licensed Professional Engineer (PE/SE)
Formally adopted Department of Transportation (DOT) maintenance decision policy
